items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: great musicians such as Louis Armstrong could play anything they could sing... Like Louis Armstrong did.

ctx.x: Yeah. But great musicians such as Louis Armstrong could play anything they could sing and they could sing anything they could play you know. Erroll Gardner used to sing [moans]. I have a great DAT recording of Albert Collins doing a guitar solo, but the amp is in another room. It’s just a microphone, his talk-back microphone and you can hear his strings going — you can hear acoustically his strings, but he’s going [moans] it sounds like a demonic possession. It’s unbelievable. I’m sorry. I’m digressing again.
What you’re describing obviously takes years of like preparation and knowledge so that you can —
